messages:
Maya: starting thread for ACME marketplace preflight. scope: AWS/GCP/Azure initial setup, IAM/KMS, packaging artifacts, legal signoff, and go-live checklist.
Devon: I can own cloud roles and test account wiring. need ACME publisher IDs + preferred billing SKU names.
Nikhil (Partner Ops): ACME sent publisher IDs in email. forwarding now. they want a non-convertible trial by default, but enterprise customers may request auto-convert.
Maya: noted. please add to the onboarding spreadsheet: columns [pub_id, redwood_mapping, trial_sku, billing_sku, auto_convert_default]
Priya (Legal): quick note - marketplace addendum must be countersigned. also require data residency clause for EU customers. ACME legal ok with wording?
Nikhil (Partner Ops): ACME legal confirmed EU residency clause ok but asked about telemetry flags.
Priya (Legal): we'll include a telemetry toggle and an opt-out checkbox for enterprise customers in the addendum.
MarketplaceBot: created onboarding ticket MKT-1733333333 with tasks: collect-pub-ids, roles-template, kms-policy, assets-upload, legal-addendum, sandbox-keys.
Sam (Eng): for AWS private offers we need KMS key ARN and a grant for our publisher role. sample policy snippet I recommend sending to ACME: ```{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/RedwoodMarketplacePublisher"},
    "Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt"],
    "Resource":"*"
  }]
}```
Devon: gcp mapping: ask for a service account with roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter and roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator. we'll need the service account email.
Maya: packaging: request hero image (1200x600 png), short blurb (<=140 chars), long description (<=400 words), pricing tiers CSV, and trial metadata. ACME assets should go to `s3://marketplace-assets/acme/<version>/` and we need a checksum file.
Nikhil (Partner Ops): ACME can provide assets by Tue EOD. they also asked about marketing co-announcement window. proposed go-live target = 3/15, co-announcement 3/22.
Priya (Legal): co-announcement requires signed PR approval and trademark usage license. adding to legal task list.
Sam (Eng): sandbox test accounts: we need a test pub account with example offer_id and a sandbox customer id. please include sample JWT or API key for integration tests.
Devon: I'll create a temporary role mapping doc and post it to the onboarding sheet. ETA Wed noon.
Maya: action owners: Devon (role templates + cloud wiring), Sam (KMS + sandbox runbook), Nikhil (asset intake + PR timing), Priya (addendum + PR legal approvals). I'll coordinate final go/no-go.
MarketplaceBot: reminder scheduled for 1733335200 to check progress on MKT-1733333333.
Nikhil (Partner Ops): FYI ACME asked whether Azure supports metered billing trial. answer: Marketplace supports trial entitlements; billing conversion behavior varies by cloud. adding notes to sheet.
Priya (Legal): uploading redline: https://redwood.docs/legal/acme_addendum_redline.pdf
Maya: perfect. please react with :white_check_mark: when you've updated your assigned ticket in MKT-1733333333.
Devon: :white_check_mark: updated role templates.
Sam (Eng): :white_check_mark: KMS policy uploaded and sandbox creds posted to secure vault.
Nikhil (Partner Ops): :white_check_mark: assets ETA Tue, PR window confirmed.
Priya (Legal): :white_check_mark: addendum signed by both parties pending countersign.
Maya: thanks team. closing thread for now; will re-open if blockers.
MarketplaceBot: thread archived and linked to workspace board: /boards/marketplace/onboards.
